name: pinflow-vscode
description: VS Code extension for viewing the local PinFlow workflow.

pinflow.refreshIntervalMs.description: How often the PinFlow sidebar polls the workspace for new run evidence (in milliseconds). Lower values are more responsive but cost more disk I/O. Range: 500-60000.

pinflow.runs.todayExpandedByDefault.description: Whether the 'Today' group in the Runs view starts expanded.

pinflow.timeFormat.description: Time format for run labels in the Runs view. '24h' shows '14:32', '12h' shows '2:32 PM'.

pinflow.notifications.runFailed.description: Show a VS Code notification toast when a PinFlow run fails.

pinflow.externalHandoff.defaultProvider.description: Default provider used when claiming an external PinFlow task via 'Claim External Task'.

pinflow.workspace.preferredFolder.description: Absolute or relative path to the workspace folder PinFlow should track. Leave empty to use auto-detection (the first folder with a running relay, then the first configured folder, then the first folder).

pinflow.preview.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the dev server's localhost URL in your browser when 'pinflow dev' detects it. Set to false to require a manual click on the Preview row.

enumDescriptions: Run pinflow init programmatically with safe defaults (no terminal opens). Recommended for most users.
Open a terminal and run 'pinflow init' interactively. Choose this if you want to step through agent/framework/monorepo prompts manually.
pinflow.onboarding.mode.description: How PinFlow should run 'pinflow init' when you click 'Setup PinFlow' on an unconfigured folder.

pinflow.overlay.theme.description: Overlay color theme. Synced bidirectionally with the browser overlay via .pinflow/overlay-settings.json. Changes here apply to all open browser tabs of this workspace within ~500 ms.

pinflow.overlay.pickerMode.description: Default capture mode in the overlay picker. 'element' picks one element on click, 'region' draws a selection rectangle, 'multi' allows multiple element picks per annotation. Synced bidirectionally with the browser overlay.

pinflow.overlay.commentEntryMode.description: Where annotation comments are entered. 'workspace' uses the right-side workspace panel, 'inline' shows a popover next to the picked element. Synced bidirectionally with the browser overlay.
